meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each year passes through three stages: the budget estimate (February before the year), the revised estimate (February of the year) and the accounts (provisional in May after the year, audited later). The RBI's tables restate a year as it moves from one stage to the next; each stage is kept as its own series.
meta.coverage: What the government pays savers: the interest rate on each small savings scheme at each reset the RBI's table lists, April 2016 on
meta.note: RBI, Small Savings Schemes (DBIE report 356, provider 'rate'; Handbook report 746). Each date is a reset listed in the table ('Since Jul.1, 2026'); the rate holds until the next date shown. Rates have been set each quarter since April 2016, linked to government bond yields. The table's outstanding amounts by scheme (end-March 2025) are in the small savings bundles.
